/obj/item/organ/brain/cybernetic/ai.name: AI-uplink brain
/obj/item/organ/brain/cybernetic/ai.reason: A brain an AI can steer. Found in one ruin, for a system crews rarely set up.

/obj/item/organ/ears/cybernetic/whisper.name: whisper-sensitive cybernetic ears
/obj/item/organ/ears/cybernetic/whisper.reason: Hear whispers from farther off, and loud noises hurt more.

/obj/item/organ/ears/cybernetic/xray.name: wall-penetrating cybernetic ears
/obj/item/organ/ears/cybernetic/xray.reason: Hear speech through walls, and loud noises hurt more. A spy's tool, not a fighter's.

/obj/item/organ/eyes/night_vision/mushro.name: fung-eye
/obj/item/organ/eyes/night_vision/mushro.reason: Night vision you can toggle, with no neural load. Placed in one jungle ruin. Same job as night vision goggles.

/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic.name: robotic eyes
/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic.reason: A working pair of robotic eyes, no better than your own.

/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/basic.name: basic robotic eyes
/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/basic.reason: Cheap replacement eyes, weak to flashes.

/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/basic/moth.name: basic robotic moth eyes
/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/basic/moth.reason: Cheap replacement eyes, weak to flashes.

/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/cyberware/d.name: Deadeye link
/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/cyberware/d.reason: Tag a target and your next three shots curve onto it, every 25 s. Bullets stop missing for a burst, but the target gets a warning and walls stop it. Load 3, 2 vouchers with no reputation.

/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/cyberware/n.name: Nightshade optics
/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/cyberware/n.note: Gives night vision with a green tint and puts a glow, visible only to the wearer, on every living body in view even in the dark (corpses glow dimmer). Flash protection stays at the robotic default, and its chrome scan only counts implants without naming them.
/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/cyberware/n.reason: Night vision with no flash weakness and a glow on every living body in view. Beats night vision goggles for 600 cr and load 1.

/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/cyberware/p.name: Prospector Suite optics
/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/cyberware/p.reason: A pulse every 10 s shows ore through rock and loot caches within 9 tiles. Great for mining and ruin crews, no help in a fight. Load 2, 2 vouchers.

/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/flashlight.name: flashlight eyes
/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/flashlight.reason: Flashlights strapped into your skull. You can't see through them. A joke.

/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/glow.name: high luminosity eyes
/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/glow.reason: A coloured torch in your face. Useful in the dark, costs a load.

/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/glow/moth.name: high luminosity moth eyes
/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/glow/moth.reason: A coloured torch in your face. Useful in the dark, costs a load.

/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/moth.name: robotic moth eyes
/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/moth.reason: A working pair of robotic eyes, no better than your own.

/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/shield.name: shielded robotic eyes
/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/shield.reason: Flash immunity with no tint, and EMP proof. Better sunglasses that don't take the slot. About 2 cr of material.

/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/shield/moth.name: shielded robotic moth eyes
/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/shield/moth.reason: Moth looks on shielded eyes. Flash immunity with no tint.

/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/thermals.name: thermal eyes
/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/thermals.reason: Same sight as thermal goggles, every living thing through walls, but sunglasses over them cancel the flash weakness. Better than the goggles, and they print with no reputation. An EMP flashes them.

/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/thermals/mo.name: thermal moth eyes
/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/thermals/mo.reason: Same as thermal eyes with moth looks. Living things through walls, flash weak.

/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/xray.name: x-ray eyes
/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/xray.reason: Everything through walls: people, objects, turfs and loot, with no flash weakness and your glasses slot still free. Beats thermal eyes for less material. One neural load, prints with no reputation.

/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/xray/moth.name: moth x-ray eyes
/obj/item/organ/eyes/robotic/xray/moth.reason: Sees everything through walls like the plain x-ray eyes, but sensitive to flashes.

/obj/item/organ/heart/cursed.name: cursed heart
/obj/item/organ/heart/cursed.note: Hitting yourself with it implants it and stops the automatic heartbeat: the owner must press a 'Pump your blood' action every 3 seconds or lose 20% of normal blood volume per miss, repeating every 2 seconds. Each pump restores 10% of normal blood volume and the base version heals nothing; the demand pauses while the player is disconnected or the body is dead.
/obj/item/organ/heart/cursed.reason: You must press a button every 3 seconds or lose blood. All downside.

/obj/item/organ/heart/cybernetic.name: basic cybernetic heart
/obj/item/organ/heart/cybernetic.note: The basic heart adds nothing beyond a heartbeat. Tier 2 and 3 hearts add 2 blood per second and ease the worst bleeding wound while blood is low (tier 2 also has a 20% chance per tick of 1 toxin damage), and the tier 3 heart gives 10 seconds of soft-crit immunity when health reaches the crit threshold, re-arming after 5 minutes. An EMP can stop any of them for 10 seconds and may leave the organ failing, which switches those effects off until surgery repairs it.

/obj/item/organ/heart/cybernetic/anomalo.name: voltaic combat cyberheart
/obj/item/organ/heart/cybernetic/anomalo.note: Does nothing special until a refined flux core is fitted (a screwdriver removes it); with a core it gives shock immunity, faster blood regeneration, one full EMP absorb (body and contents) with a 1 minute recharge, and now and then tops up a drained power cell the owner carries. Reaching the crit threshold starts 30 seconds of voltaic overdrive (no crit, no pain, healing 5 of each damage type per tick while at the threshold, no damage slowdown) on a 5 minute cooldown. A cored heart can be self-implanted in 5 seconds for 100 brute to the chest, and removing a cored heart discharges a tesla zap and destroys it. / The basic heart adds nothing beyond a heartbeat. Tier 2 and 3 hearts add 2 blood per second and ease the worst bleeding wound while blood is low (tier 2 also has a 20% chance per tick of 1 toxin damage), and the tier 3 heart gives 10 seconds of soft-crit immunity when health reaches the crit threshold, re-arming after 5 minutes. An EMP can stop any of them for 10 seconds and may leave the organ failing, which switches those effects off until surgery repairs it.
/obj/item/organ/heart/cybernetic/anomalo.reason: With a refined flux core: 30 s where you can't go into crit at all and heal 5 of everything a tick at the edge, every 5 minutes, plus no shocks and it eats one EMP a minute. Rated with the core, which costs 8,000 cr or a field anomaly.

/obj/item/organ/heart/cybernetic/meridia.name: Meridian heart
/obj/item/organ/heart/cybernetic/meridia.note: Thirty seconds after its owner dies it fires an internal defibrillation that revives them (blocked if they couldn't be defibbed: DNR, no head or brain, husked), and the charge takes 20 minutes to return. Otherwise it is a basic cybernetic heart with the same EMP vulnerability. / The basic heart adds nothing beyond a heartbeat. Tier 2 and 3 hearts add 2 blood per second and ease the worst bleeding wound while blood is low (tier 2 also has a 20% chance per tick of 1 toxin damage), and the tier 3 heart gives 10 seconds of soft-crit immunity when health reaches the crit threshold, re-arming after 5 minutes. An EMP can stop any of them for 10 seconds and may leave the organ failing, which switches those effects off until surgery repairs it.
/obj/item/organ/heart/cybernetic/meridia.reason: Authored unique. Thirty seconds after you die it revives you however hurt the body is, in deep crit, on a 20 minute recharge. A rare medical cache prize.

/obj/item/organ/heart/cybernetic/tier2.name: cybernetic heart
/obj/item/organ/heart/cybernetic/tier2.note: The basic heart adds nothing beyond a heartbeat. Tier 2 and 3 hearts add 2 blood per second and ease the worst bleeding wound while blood is low (tier 2 also has a 20% chance per tick of 1 toxin damage), and the tier 3 heart gives 10 seconds of soft-crit immunity when health reaches the crit threshold, re-arming after 5 minutes. An EMP can stop any of them for 10 seconds and may leave the organ failing, which switches those effects off until surgery repairs it.
/obj/item/organ/heart/cybernetic/tier2.reason: Regrows blood and eases the worst bleed, with a small chance of toxin.

/obj/item/organ/heart/cybernetic/tier3.name: upgraded cybernetic heart
/obj/item/organ/heart/cybernetic/tier3.note: The basic heart adds nothing beyond a heartbeat. Tier 2 and 3 hearts add 2 blood per second and ease the worst bleeding wound while blood is low (tier 2 also has a 20% chance per tick of 1 toxin damage), and the tier 3 heart gives 10 seconds of soft-crit immunity when health reaches the crit threshold, re-arming after 5 minutes. An EMP can stop any of them for 10 seconds and may leave the organ failing, which switches those effects off until surgery repairs it.
/obj/item/organ/heart/cybernetic/tier3.reason: Regrows blood, eases the worst bleed, and 10 s of no soft crit every 5 minutes. A good cheap medical heart. One neural load.

/obj/item/organ/heart/freedom.name: heart of freedom
/obj/item/organ/heart/freedom.note: When the owner's health drops below 5 (random 25 to 60 second cooldown) it heals 15 brute and 15 burn (organic bodies only) and adds 10 ephedrine if they carry under 20. Its robotic flag also prevents heart attacks.
/obj/item/organ/heart/freedom.reason: Heals 15 brute and 15 burn with ephedrine whenever you're nearly dead, every 25 to 60 s, and no heart attacks. A rare drop from one mutant clown.

/obj/item/organ/heart/gland/ventcrawling.name: fleshy mass
/obj/item/organ/heart/gland/ventcrawling.reason: An unlabelled abductor gland that lets you crawl through vents after a few minutes. Rare ruin spawn, and it looks like the bad glands.

/obj/item/organ/legion_tumour.name: legion tumour
/obj/item/organ/legion_tumour.note: Used on a living target who is conscious or in soft crit (and the tumour isn't failing) it gives the regenerative-core heal and a 2 minute bad-mood effect and is consumed; used on a human any lower, or when the tumour is failing, a legion skull appears and infests them. Left implanted it matures in 80 second stages (3 times faster once failing): from stage 2 it occasionally heals the host and causes spasms and vomiting, from stage 4 it spits out legion skulls and hurts the host, and at stage 5 the host is turned into a Legion.
/obj/item/organ/legion_tumour.reason: A one-use heal of 25 and 25 if you use it, and a slow death by legion if you leave it in.

/obj/item/organ/liver/cybernetic/tier2.name: cybernetic liver
/obj/item/organ/liver/cybernetic/tier2.reason: Handles a little more toxin than a real liver.

/obj/item/organ/liver/cybernetic/tier3.name: upgraded cybernetic liver
/obj/item/organ/liver/cybernetic/tier3.reason: Handles 10 units of toxin without damage and shrugs off alcohol. Medical upkeep, one neural load.

/obj/item/organ/lungs/cybernetic/tier2.name: cybernetic lungs
/obj/item/organ/lungs/cybernetic/tier2.reason: Needs a little less oxygen than real lungs.

/obj/item/organ/lungs/cybernetic/tier3.name: upgraded cybernetic lungs
/obj/item/organ/lungs/cybernetic/tier3.reason: Breathes thin air, cold air and a little plasma without harm. Medical upkeep, one neural load.

/obj/item/organ/monster_core/brimdust_sa.name: brimdust sac
/obj/item/organ/monster_core/brimdust_sa.note: Used in hand it coats the user in 3 stacks of explosive dust and is consumed; implanted it adds 1 stack every 30 seconds in low pressure and can be exhaled (90 second cooldown) as a 2-tile smoke cloud coating everyone nearby. Each time a coated mob takes brute damage (5 seconds apart), it blasts everything within 1 tile for 40 burn and uses a stack (max 3); at normal pressure the blast is a quarter strength, hurts the coated mob too and slows them for 4 seconds. Being cleaned washes the dust off, and the sac itself explodes if hit by fire, a hot item or an explosion.
/obj/item/organ/monster_core/brimdust_sa.reason: Coats you in dust that deals 40 burn to anyone next to you when you're hit, up to three times, weak at normal pressure. Strong on airless planets. From brimdemons.

/obj/item/organ/monster_core/regenerativ.name: regenerative core
/obj/item/organ/monster_core/regenerativ.note: Smeared on a living creature it heals 25 brute and 25 burn, clears stuns and knockdowns, resets body temperature and removes damage slowdown for a minute, with a 2 minute mood penalty; it goes inert 4 minutes after being taken unless stabilised. Implanted, it fully heals the owner on use or automatically when they reach the crit threshold, and is consumed.
/obj/item/organ/monster_core/regenerativ.reason: Smear for 25 brute and 25 burn and clear stuns, or implant it for one full heal when you hit crit. Goes inert in 4 minutes unless stabilized. Farmed from hivelords.

/obj/item/organ/monster_core/regenerativ.name: regenerative core
/obj/item/organ/monster_core/regenerativ.note: Smeared on a living creature it heals 25 brute and 25 burn, clears stuns and knockdowns, resets body temperature and removes damage slowdown for a minute, with a 2 minute mood penalty; it goes inert 4 minutes after being taken unless stabilised. Implanted, it fully heals the owner on use or automatically when they reach the crit threshold, and is consumed.
/obj/item/organ/monster_core/regenerativ.reason: The legion's version of the core: one full heal when implanted, 25 and 25 when smeared. Farmed from legions, and Vex buys it.

/obj/item/organ/monster_core/rush_gland.name: rush gland
/obj/item/organ/monster_core/rush_gland.note: Used in hand it gives 3 seconds of fast running that ignores slowdown and tentacle grabs; implanted it gives 5 seconds, triggers by itself at 30 health or less, and has a 90 second cooldown. While rushing, running into a living creature knocks both down for 5 seconds with 40 stamina and 20 brute damage, and running into a dense object at normal pressure does the same to the runner and ends the rush.
/obj/item/organ/monster_core/rush_gland.reason: A few seconds of fast running that ignores slowdowns, automatic at 30 health, every 90 s. Cheap escape, from lobstrosities.

/obj/item/organ/stomach/cybernetic/tier2.name: cybernetic stomach
/obj/item/organ/stomach/cybernetic/tier2.reason: Copes with bad food. No bearing on a fight.

/obj/item/organ/stomach/cybernetic/tier3.name: upgraded cybernetic stomach
/obj/item/organ/stomach/cybernetic/tier3.reason: Copes with bad food. No bearing on a fight.

/obj/item/organ/stomach/ethereal.name: biological battery
/obj/item/organ/stomach/ethereal.note: Replaces hunger with an electric charge that drains steadily and refills from shocks (shock damage doubled into charge) or a borg charger. Running empty or low causes toxin damage and bad mood; overcharging causes toxin damage, and at the top end gives a 5% per second chance of a 5 second warm-up followed by a lightning discharge, 10 seconds of paralysis and a 10% chance of a heart attack.
/obj/item/organ/stomach/ethereal.reason: Runs on electric charge instead of food. A species part, more trouble than it's worth on anyone else.

/obj/item/organ/tail/cat.name: tail
/obj/item/organ/tail/cat.reason: A tail or wings. Looks, plus some moth flight in rare conditions.

/obj/item/organ/tail/lizard.name: lizard tail
/obj/item/organ/tail/lizard.reason: A tail or wings. Looks, plus some moth flight in rare conditions.

/obj/item/organ/tail/lizard/fake.name: fabricated lizard tail
/obj/item/organ/tail/lizard/fake.reason: A tail or wings. Looks, plus some moth flight in rare conditions.

/obj/item/organ/tail/monkey.name: monkey tail
/obj/item/organ/tail/monkey.reason: A tail or wings. Looks, plus some moth flight in rare conditions.

/obj/item/organ/tongue.name: tongue
/obj/item/organ/tongue.reason: A tongue. Changes how you talk.

/obj/item/organ/tongue/alien.name: alien tongue
/obj/item/organ/tongue/alien.reason: A tongue. Changes how you talk.

/obj/item/organ/tongue/bone.name: bone "tongue"
/obj/item/organ/tongue/bone.reason: A tongue. Changes how you talk.

/obj/item/organ/tongue/bone/plasmaman.name: plasma bone "tongue"
/obj/item/organ/tongue/bone/plasmaman.reason: A tongue. Changes how you talk.

/obj/item/organ/tongue/cat.name: felinid tongue
/obj/item/organ/tongue/cat.reason: A tongue. Changes how you talk.

/obj/item/organ/tongue/ethereal.name: electric discharger
/obj/item/organ/tongue/ethereal.reason: A tongue. Changes how you talk.

/obj/item/organ/tongue/fly.name: proboscis
/obj/item/organ/tongue/fly.reason: A tongue. Changes how you talk.

/obj/item/organ/tongue/lizard.name: forked tongue
/obj/item/organ/tongue/lizard.reason: A tongue. Changes how you talk.

/obj/item/organ/tongue/rat.name: mutated rat-tongue
/obj/item/organ/tongue/rat.note: Squeaks loudly now and then (5% each life tick), turns a lone 'hi' into 'Cheesed to meet you!', makes the wearer say a line and gives the receiver a mood event when handing over an item, and likes dairy. It counts toward the four-piece rat set that grants ventcrawling without clothes.
/obj/item/organ/tongue/rat.reason: A tongue. Changes how you talk.

/obj/item/organ/tongue/robot.name: robotic voicebox
/obj/item/organ/tongue/robot.reason: A tongue. Changes how you talk.

/obj/item/organ/tongue/snail.name: radula
/obj/item/organ/tongue/snail.reason: A tongue. Changes how you talk.

/obj/item/organ/tongue/zombie.name: rotting tongue
/obj/item/organ/tongue/zombie.reason: A tongue. Changes how you talk.

/obj/item/organ/vocal_cords/colossus.name: divine vocal cords
/obj/item/organ/vocal_cords/colossus.reason: A colossus trophy. Speak a command and everyone nearby stops, drops or takes damage. No other item controls a fight this hard.

/obj/item/organ/wings/moth.name: moth wings
/obj/item/organ/wings/moth.note: Lets the wearer fly with stabilised thrust only when there is no gravity, they have a client, a suit isn't hiding the wings and the air is at least 0.85 atm; it also softens falls. The wings burn off at 800 K while on fire, ending flight and fall softening until the wearer is fully healed.
/obj/item/organ/wings/moth.reason: A tail or wings. Looks, plus some moth flight in rare conditions.

method: Judged by hand against each slot's rivals and the eyewear anchors. Plain replacement organs and limbs are none. Robotic organs cost 1 neural load and organic ones cost none, which counts for and against them.
